The mother of an OpenAI whistleblower who died in disputed circumstances speaks to Tucker Carlson in this episode. Her son, a former researcher, had raised concerns about the company's training data before his death. Police ruled the death a suicide, and his family does not accept that finding.

She tells her son's story and calls for a full investigation, naming Sam Altman and OpenAI in her demands. Carlson asks what evidence drives her doubts and what officials have told the family. The episode is a grieving parent's charge, delivered in full. Concerned viewers hear her case in her own words.
